rows.text: Sul bagnato le ruote hanno meno aderenza che sull’asciutto: lo spazio necessario per fermarsi aumenta.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rule 227, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: wet roads reduce tyre grip and increase stopping distance.

rows.text: Quando l’acqua non viene evacuata abbastanza, si forma un velo tra pneumatico e strada: la ruota perde contatto e aderenza.
evidence: Texas Department of Transportation, Hydraulics Manual, Hydroplaning, https://www.txdot.gov/content/txdotoms/us/en/manuals/des/hyd/chapter-10--storm-drains/section-4--pavement-drainage/hydroplaning.html: when tread and pavement drainage capacity is exceeded, a water wedge can lift the tire and eliminate friction; speed and tread depth affect hydroplaning.

Georgia Department of Driver Services, Drivers Manual, Hydroplaning, https://dds.georgia.gov/drivers-manual: tires channel water away; hydroplaning can remove road contact and cause an uncontrollable skid; adequate water-channeling tread helps prevent it.

rows.text: Un battistrada molto consumato evacua meno acqua: a parità di condizioni l’aquaplaning può iniziare a una velocità inferiore.
evidence: NHTSA, Tire pressure FMVSS 138, pp. V-56–V-57, https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/fmvss/tirepressure-fmvss-138.pdf: speed, tread depth and water depth affect hydroplaning; worn tread is less able to remove water.

NASA, A systematic experimental investigation of significant parameters affecting model tire hydroplaning, conclusions, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/archive/nasa/casi.ntrs.nasa.gov/19740003931.pdf: hydroplaning inception speed increases with tread depth.

Texas Department of Transportation, Hydraulics Manual, Hydroplaning, https://www.txdot.gov/content/txdotoms/us/en/manuals/des/hyd/chapter-10--storm-drains/section-4--pavement-drainage/hydroplaning.html: when tread and pavement drainage capacity is exceeded, a water wedge can lift the tire and eliminate friction; speed and tread depth affect hydroplaning.

rows.text: Gli intagli permettono all’acqua di uscire dalla zona di contatto. Se non basta, il pneumatico può sollevarsi sul velo d’acqua.
evidence: Texas Department of Transportation, Hydraulics Manual, Hydroplaning, https://www.txdot.gov/content/txdotoms/us/en/manuals/des/hyd/chapter-10--storm-drains/section-4--pavement-drainage/hydroplaning.html: when tread and pavement drainage capacity is exceeded, a water wedge can lift the tire and eliminate friction; speed and tread depth affect hydroplaning.

Georgia Department of Driver Services, Drivers Manual, Hydroplaning, https://dds.georgia.gov/drivers-manual: tires channel water away; hydroplaning can remove road contact and cause an uncontrollable skid; adequate water-channeling tread helps prevent it.

rows.text: Il rischio aumenta con la velocità, non con la sua riduzione: l’acqua ha meno tempo per uscire dalla zona di contatto.
evidence: NHTSA, Tire pressure FMVSS 138, pp. V-56–V-57, https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/fmvss/tirepressure-fmvss-138.pdf: speed, tread depth and water depth affect hydroplaning; worn tread is less able to remove water.

Pennsylvania Driver’s Manual, Managing Speed, https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dmv/driver-services/pennsylvania-drivers-manual/online-drivers-manual/everyday-driving-skills/managing-speed: faster tyres are less effective at clearing water; reducing speed reduces hydroplaning.

rows.text: L’aquaplaning toglie aderenza e può causare sbandamento e perdita di controllo, anziché ridurli.
evidence: Texas Department of Transportation, Hydraulics Manual, Hydroplaning, https://www.txdot.gov/content/txdotoms/us/en/manuals/des/hyd/chapter-10--storm-drains/section-4--pavement-drainage/hydroplaning.html: when tread and pavement drainage capacity is exceeded, a water wedge can lift the tire and eliminate friction; speed and tread depth affect hydroplaning.

Georgia Department of Driver Services, Drivers Manual, Hydroplaning, https://dds.georgia.gov/drivers-manual: tires channel water away; hydroplaning can remove road contact and cause an uncontrollable skid; adequate water-channeling tread helps prevent it.

rows.text: La profondità del battistrada conta: se è molto consumato, evacua meno acqua e il rischio di aquaplaning aumenta.
evidence: NHTSA, Tire pressure FMVSS 138, pp. V-56–V-57, https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/fmvss/tirepressure-fmvss-138.pdf: speed, tread depth and water depth affect hydroplaning; worn tread is less able to remove water.

rows.text: Neve e ghiaccio riducono l’aderenza. Una velocità moderata lascia più possibilità di controllare il veicolo e fermarsi.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

rows.text: Su neve o ghiaccio lo spazio di arresto aumenta: una distanza maggiore lascia più spazio per fermarsi.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

rows.text: Con poca aderenza un’accelerazione brusca può far slittare le ruote. Occorre accelerare gradualmente.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

Oregon DMV, Commercial Driver Manual §2.19, https://www.oregon.gov/odot/DMV/Pages/Online_CDL_Manual_2/Section_2.aspx: excessive acceleration can spin drive wheels and cause a skid, particularly on ice or snow.
Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Drivers Manual §2.2, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-22: accelerate gradually when traction is poor; excessive power can spin the drive wheels.

rows.text: Frenare con forza su neve o ghiaccio può causare slittamento. È preferibile rallentare per tempo e frenare dolcemente.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

rows.text: Accelerare al massimo in partenza può far slittare le ruote sulla superficie scivolosa; occorre accelerare dolcemente.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Drivers Manual §2.2, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-22: accelerate gradually when traction is poor; excessive power can spin the drive wheels.

rows.text: Una sterzata brusca su neve o ghiaccio può far perdere aderenza e controllo. Occorre prevedere l’ostacolo e manovrare dolcemente.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

rows.text: In curva su fondo scivoloso è più facile perdere aderenza: si deve rallentare prima della curva e percorrerla con prudenza.
evidence: UK Department for International Development, Motorcycle Rider Training Instructor Manual, pp. 56–58, https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf: slippery surfaces reduce traction; slow before curves and avoid sudden inputs.

rows.text: Con meno aderenza serve più spazio per arrestarsi. Aumentare la distanza aiuta a fermarsi se il veicolo davanti rallenta.
evidence: UK Department for International Development, Motorcycle Rider Training Instructor Manual, pp. 56–58, https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf: slippery surfaces reduce traction; slow before curves and avoid sudden inputs.

UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rule 227, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: wet roads reduce tyre grip and increase stopping distance.

rows.text: Una velocità moderata e il più possibile uniforme riducono la necessità di manovre brusche, che sul fondo scivoloso possono provocare slittamenti.
evidence: UK Department for International Development, Motorcycle Rider Training Instructor Manual, pp. 56–58, https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf: slippery surfaces reduce traction; slow before curves and avoid sudden inputs.

rows.text: Un’accelerazione brusca può far slittare le ruote. Sul fondo scivoloso si procede lentamente e si accelera con gradualità.
evidence: UK Department for International Development, Motorcycle Rider Training Instructor Manual, pp. 56–58, https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf: slippery surfaces reduce traction; slow before curves and avoid sudden inputs.

Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Drivers Manual §2.2, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-22: accelerate gradually when traction is poor; excessive power can spin the drive wheels.

rows.text: Frenare bruscamente in curva può provocare una perdita di aderenza. Si rallenta prima della curva, frenando progressivamente.
evidence: UK Department for International Development, Motorcycle Rider Training Instructor Manual, pp. 56–58, https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf: slippery surfaces reduce traction; slow before curves and avoid sudden inputs.

rows.text: Colpi di manubrio improvvisi possono far perdere aderenza. Su fondo scivoloso le manovre devono essere dolci e progressive.
evidence: UK Department for International Development, Motorcycle Rider Training Instructor Manual, pp. 56–58, https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf: slippery surfaces reduce traction; slow before curves and avoid sudden inputs.

rows.text: L’acqua sulla strada riduce l’aderenza tra pneumatico e asfalto, rendendo più difficile frenare e controllare il veicolo.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rule 227, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: wet roads reduce tyre grip and increase stopping distance.

rows.text: Le foglie, soprattutto se bagnate, formano uno strato scivoloso tra pneumatico e strada e possono ridurre l’aderenza.
evidence: London Fire Brigade, Motorbikes, https://www.london-fire.gov.uk/safety/road-safety/motorbikes/: wet leaves and diesel spills are motorcycle skid hazards.

Washington Department of Licensing, Motorcycle operator manual, Surface hazards, https://dol.wa.gov/driver-licenses-and-permits/motorcycle/motorcycle-endorsement-training-and-testing/motorcycle-operator-manual/motorcycle-operator-manual-text-only: leaves and oil spots are slippery surfaces that affect traction.

rows.text: Neve e ghiaccio rendono il fondo scivoloso: le ruote hanno meno presa e possono slittare più facilmente.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

rows.text: L’olio forma uno strato scivoloso sull’asfalto e riduce la presa dei pneumatici sulla strada.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rule 227, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: wet roads reduce tyre grip and increase stopping distance.

rows.text: Una bassa velocità non rende di per sé il fondo meno aderente. Sul bagnato, invece, la velocità elevata aumenta il rischio di aquaplaning.
evidence: NHTSA, Tire pressure FMVSS 138, pp. V-56–V-57, https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/fmvss/tirepressure-fmvss-138.pdf: speed, tread depth and water depth affect hydroplaning; worn tread is less able to remove water.

rows.text: I giri del motore da soli non determinano l’aderenza tra ruota e asfalto: contano le condizioni del fondo e dei pneumatici. Un’accelerazione brusca può comunque far slittare la ruota.
evidence: UK Department for International Development, Motorcycle Rider Training Instructor Manual, pp. 56–58, https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf: slippery surfaces reduce traction; slow before curves and avoid sudden inputs.

Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Drivers Manual §2.2, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-22: accelerate gradually when traction is poor; excessive power can spin the drive wheels.
